ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/zlib-ng/vulnerability_FZ_3/input-002; adapted: the conversion replay's input-002 (7 bytes, 'PK\x03\x04\x03\x10u'), produced by exploit.sh's own random generator; the dataset's poc_*.zip are Git LFS pointers and the report's poc_crash.bin was not shipped. Self-check confirms it crashes the vulnerable build (heap-buffer-overflow in crc32_copy_small) and not the secure one; verified locally against zlib-ng @c2712b8 with the FZ_3 diff on an AVX-512 host. Alternate candidate input-010 (15 bytes).)

review.note: report: fuzzer_minigzip on /workspace/run/attempt/poc_crash.bin, which is not shipped; the exploit's own 64 random zips did not crash (run.out)

category5.design: The injected `while (len >= 7)` with 8-byte steps makes a 7-byte tail wrap len to SIZE_MAX, overflowing the CRC copy. A 7- or 15-byte gzip chunk (a 7/15-byte input through fuzzer_minigzip's deflate/inflate CRC-copy) triggers it; the dataset's own PoCs are LFS pointers, so the ground truth is a replay-captured 7-byte input.
